post.description:
Pause the logged-in customer's own subscription from the customer portal. The subscription must belong to the currently authenticated customer and is looked up by its UUID, not its numeric ID.

**Access policy:** `CustomerFrontendPolicy`

**Access policy:** `CustomerFrontendPolicy`

parameters.name: subscription_uuid
parameters.description: UUID of the subscription to pause. Must belong to the currently authenticated customer.

example.message: Your subscription has been successfully paused
Your subscription has been successfully paused

value.message: Your subscription has been successfully paused

422.description: The requester is not logged in, has no customer record, the subscription UUID does not belong to them, or the subscription cannot be paused in its current state (the error message reflects which case occurred).

401.description: Not authenticated. The request carried no valid WordPress credentials.

example.message: Sorry, you are not allowed to do that.

403.description: Authenticated, but the user lacks the required capability.
